title: Dining Room and Cafeteria Attendants and Bartender Helpers
description: Facilitate food service. Clean tables; remove dirty dishes; replace soiled table linens; set tables; replenish supply of clean linens, silverware, glassware, and dishes; supply service bar with food; and serve items such as water, condiments, and coffee to patrons.

tasks.text: Serve ice water, coffee, rolls, or butter to patrons.
Scrape and stack dirty dishes and carry dishes and other tableware to kitchens for cleaning.
Wipe tables or seats with dampened cloths or replace dirty tablecloths.
Set tables with clean linens, condiments, or other supplies.
Greet and seat customers.
Clean up spilled food or drink or broken dishes and remove empty bottles and trash.
Carry food, dishes, trays, or silverware from kitchens or supply departments to serving counters.
Perform serving, cleaning, or stocking duties in establishments, such as cafeterias or dining rooms, to facilitate customer service.
Carry trays from food counters to tables for cafeteria patrons.
Wash glasses or other serving equipment at bars.
Serve food to customers when waiters or waitresses need assistance.
Carry linens to or from laundry areas.
Clean and polish counters, shelves, walls, furniture, or equipment in food service areas or other areas of restaurants and mop or vacuum floors.
Mix and prepare flavors for mixed drinks.
Fill beverage or ice dispensers.
Replenish supplies of food or equipment at steam tables or service bars.
Stock cabinets or serving areas with condiments and refill condiment containers.
Garnish foods and position them on tables to make them visible and accessible.
Slice and pit fruit used to garnish drinks.
Stock refrigerating units with wines or bottled beer or replace empty beer kegs.
Run cash registers.
Maintain adequate supplies of items, such as clean linens, silverware, glassware, dishes, or trays.

clusters.label: Communicating with People Outside the Organization

tasks.text: Locate items requested by customers.

skills.name: Active Listening
skills.def: Giving full attention to what other people are saying, taking time to understand the points being made, asking questions as appropriate, and not interrupting at inappropriate times.

skills.name: Coordination
skills.def: Adjusting actions in relation to others' actions.

skills.name: Service Orientation
skills.def: Actively looking for ways to help people.

skills.name: Speaking
skills.def: Talking to others to convey information effectively.

skills.name: Monitoring
skills.def: Monitoring/Assessing performance of yourself, other individuals, or organizations to make improvements or take corrective action.

skills.name: Social Perceptiveness
skills.def: Being aware of others' reactions and understanding why they react as they do.

skills.name: Judgment and Decision Making
skills.def: Considering the relative costs and benefits of potential actions to choose the most appropriate one.

skills.name: Critical Thinking
skills.def: Using logic and reasoning to identify the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions, or approaches to problems.

skills.name: Web page creation and editing software
skills.def: Software to develop or edit web sites or individual pages. Examples: Facebook.

skills.name: Spreadsheet software
skills.def: Software to create or edit numbers or text organized into rows and columns of cells. May include formulas which recalculate values based on other cells. Examples: Microsoft Excel.

skills.name: Operating system software
skills.def: Software to provide the operational interface to a computer and provide higher-level services and APIs. Examples: Microsoft Windows.

skills.name: Point of sale POS software
skills.def: Software to enable billing and purchase of goods or services at retail markets or shops. May provide sales reports. Examples: Cafe Cartel Systems, Plexis Software Plexis POS, RestaurantPlus PRO.
